stem: What is most likely the main reason this fence was built?

options.label: F
options.text: To stop sand from sliding or blowing onto the road and covering it up

options.label: G
options.text: To prevent a delta from forming at the bottom of the dune

options.label: H
options.text: To keep water off the road

options.label: J
